units.note: Greek breaks mid-sentence (καὶ τῆς μὲν κατὰ τὴν Ἰβηρίαν Καρχηδόνος | τοῦτον τὸν τρόπον ἐγένοντο κύριοι Ῥωμαῖοι, 10.16.1); English completes the sentence at end of ch.15 and repeats it at start of ch.16. Seam duplication, not a translation error; flag for apparatus.
ἀεὶ πρὸς τὸ δεικνύειν is textually doubtful; 'ready for whatever is indicated' keeps the general sense without forcing a reading.
Greek ends in lacuna (πρόνοιαν ***); English correctly breaks off with a dash.
